RecycleBinSettings.description: Configuration for Limbo Umbraco Recycle Bin.

RecycleBinContentSettings.description: Configuration for automatic cleanup of the content recycle bin.

Enabled.description: Whether automatic cleanup of the content recycle bin is enabled.

DeleteAfterDays.description: The number of days content may remain in the recycle bin before it is permanently deleted.

RecycleBinMediaSettings.description: Configuration for automatic cleanup of the media recycle bin.

Enabled.description: Whether automatic cleanup of the media recycle bin is enabled.

DeleteAfterDays.description: The number of days media may remain in the recycle bin before it is permanently deleted.
